judge_input.description:
### Context

The way that the AWS Bedrock service in Prowler is currently implemented, it only ever goes and fetches the very first page of results, and it does this for both the Guardrails and the Agents. What this particular limitation ends up meaning is that, in any environments that happen to have a large number of these resources in them (that is to say, a number of them which exceeds the default AWS page size that is in effect), Prowler ends up failing to properly detect and to scan all of them, and this failure in turn ends up leading directly to security assessments that turn out to be incomplete.

### Description

This PR goes right ahead and implements proper pagination logic for both of the [list_guardrails](cci:1://file:///prowler/prowler/providers/aws/services/bedrock/bedrock_service.py:54:4-84:13) and the [list_agents](cci:1://file:///prowler/prowler/providers/aws/services/bedrock/bedrock_service.py:143:4-177:13) methods, both of which happen to live in [bedrock_service.py](cci:7://file:///prowler/prowler/providers/aws/services/bedrock/bedrock_service.py:0:0-0:0).

Changes include:
- Updated the [[prowler/providers/aws/services/bedrock/bedrock_service.py](cci:7://file:///prowler/prowler/providers/aws/services/bedrock/bedrock_service.py:0:0-0:0)](https://github.com/prowler-cloud/prowler/blob/master/prowler/providers/aws/services/bedrock/bedrock_service.py) logic so that it now goes and iterates its way through each and every one of the available pages of the results, doing so specifically by using the `nextToken` value that is provided to it by the AWS API.
- Added a brand new unit test file, namely [[tests/providers/aws/services/bedrock/bedrock_service_pagination_test.py](cci:7://file:///prowler/tests/providers/aws/services/bedrock/bedrock_service_pagination_test.py:0:0-0:0)](https://github.com/prowler-cloud/prowler/blob/master/tests/providers/aws/services/bedrock/bedrock_service_pagination_test.py), and this was in order to properly verify that the pagination logic does correctly go and collect the resources right across the multiple pages.
- Added some inline documentation over to the code itself, doing so in order to explain the whole pagination flow along with the mechanics of the loop.

### Steps to review

1.  **Code Review**: Go and verify the changes over in [[prowler/providers/aws/services/bedrock/bedrock_service.py](cci:7://file:///prowler/prowler/providers/aws/services/bedrock/bedrock_service.py:0:0-0:0)](https://github.com/prowler-cloud/prowler/blob/master/prowler/providers/aws/services/bedrock/bedrock_service.py). Make sure that the `while True` loops there are each correctly handling the `nextToken`, and that they do so for both the Guardrails and also for the Agents.
2.  **Test Verification**:
    - Run the new unit tests that were added:
      ```bash
      poetry run pytest tests/providers/aws/services/bedrock/bedrock_service_pagination_test.py
      ```
    - Run the existing tests as well, so as to ensure that there are no regressions that have crept in:
      ```bash
      poetry run pytest tests/providers/aws/services/bedrock/bedrock_service_test.py
      ```

### Checklist

- Are there any new checks at all that are included in this particular PR here? **No**
    - And if so, then do we happen to need to go and update the permissions for the provider in question? N/A
- [x] Review whether the code is being properly covered by tests.
- [x] Review whether the code is documented following this spec https://github.com/google/styleguide/blob/gh-pages/pyguide.md#38-comments-and-docstrings
- [ ] Review whether a backport is needed.
- [ ] Review whether it is needed to change the [Readme.md](https://github.com/prowler-cloud/prowler/blob/master/README.md).
- [x] Ensure that new entries are added to the [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/prowler-cloud/prowler/blob/master/prowler/CHANGELOG.md), if applicable.

+class TestBedrockPagination:
+    """Test suite for Bedrock Guardrail pagination logic."""
+
+    def test_list_guardrails_pagination(self):
+        """Test that list_guardrails iterates through all pages."""
+        # Mock the audit_info
+        audit_info = MagicMock()
+        audit_info.audited_partition = "aws"
+        audit_info.audited_account = "123456789012"
+        audit_info.audit_resources = None
+
+        # Mock the regional client
+        regional_client = MagicMock()
+        regional_client.region = "us-east-1"
+
+        # Mock paginator
+        paginator = MagicMock()
+        page1 = {
+            "guardrails": [
+                {
+                    "id": "g-1",
+                    "name": "guardrail-1",
+                    "arn": "arn:aws:bedrock:us-east-1:123456789012:guardrail/g-1",
+                }
+            ]
+        }
+        page2 = {
+            "guardrails": [
+                {
+                    "id": "g-2",
+                    "name": "guardrail-2",
+                    "arn": "arn:aws:bedrock:us-east-1:123456789012:guardrail/g-2",
+                }
+            ]
+        }
+        paginator.paginate.return_value = [page1, page2]
+        regional_client.get_paginator.return_value = paginator
+
+        # Initialize service and inject mock client
+        bedrock_service = Bedrock(audit_info)
+        bedrock_service.regional_clients = {"us-east-1": regional_client}
+        bedrock_service.guardrails = {}  # Clear any init side effects
+
+        # Run the method under test
+        bedrock_service._list_guardrails(regional_client)
+
+        # Assertions
+        assert len(bedrock_service.guardrails) == 2
+        assert (
+            "arn:aws:bedrock:us-east-1:123456789012:guardrail/g-1"
+            in bedrock_service.guardrails
+        )
+        assert (
+            "arn:aws:bedrock:us-east-1:123456789012:guardrail/g-2"
+            in bedrock_service.guardrails
+        )
+
+        # Verify paginator was used
+        regional_client.get_paginator.assert_called_once_with("list_guardrails")
+        paginator.paginate.assert_called_once()
+
+
+class TestBedrockAgentPagination:
+    """Test suite for Bedrock Agent pagination logic."""
+
+    def test_list_agents_pagination(self):
+        """Test that list_agents iterates through all pages."""
+        # Mock the audit_info
+        audit_info = MagicMock()
+        audit_info.audited_partition = "aws"
+        audit_info.audited_account = "123456789012"
+        audit_info.audit_resources = None
+
+        # Mock the regional client
+        regional_client = MagicMock()
+        regional_client.region = "us-east-1"
+
+        # Mock paginator
+        paginator = MagicMock()
+        page1 = {
+            "agentSummaries": [
+                {
+                    "agentId": "agent-1",
+                    "agentName": "agent-name-1",
+                    "agentStatus": "PREPARED",
+                }
+            ]
+        }
+        page2 = {
+            "agentSummaries": [
+                {
+                    "agentId": "agent-2",
+                    "agentName": "agent-name-2",
+                    "agentStatus": "PREPARED",
+                }
+            ]
+        }
+        paginator.paginate.return_value = [page1, page2]
+        regional_client.get_paginator.return_value = paginator
+
+        # Initialize service and inject mock client
+        bedrock_agent_service = BedrockAgent(audit_info)
+        bedrock_agent_service.regional_clients = {"us-east-1": regional_client}
+        bedrock_agent_service.agents = {}  # Clear init side effects
+        bedrock_agent_service.audited_account = "123456789012"
+
+        # Run method
+        bedrock_agent_service._list_agents(regional_client)
+
+        # Assertions
+        assert len(bedrock_agent_service.agents) == 2

+            in bedrock_agent_service.agents
+        )
+        assert (
+            "arn:aws:bedrock:us-east-1:123456789012:agent/agent-2"
+            in bedrock_agent_service.agents
+        )
+
+        # Verify paginator was used
+        regional_client.get_paginator.assert_called_once_with("list_agents")
+        paginator.paginate.assert_called_once()
